title: In the right place, too early
prompt: It is 09:55 ET. Read the chart and decide.

intro.beginner: Price has dropped into a higher-timeframe area and swept a low. Ask what has actually changed on the chart since it got there.
intro.advanced: 09:55 ET. Location is there. Is anything else?

whyNot.label: buying the sweep
whyNot.why: The location is right and nothing has confirmed. The sweep only says there is liquidity taken; a break of structure with displacement says price has turned. Entering now is buying the idea before it has happened, with the same stop and a worse chance.

whyNot.label: giving up on it
whyNot.why: No confirmation yet isn't no trade. Location this good tends to produce confirmation; passing entirely loses a valid setup that appears half an hour later.

reference.summary: Price swept the low into a 1H gap in discount and then stalled. Location is excellent and there's no confirmation: no displacement, no break of structure. The trade appears later, when displacement arrives and price retraces into its gap.

bias.why: Higher highs and higher lows on the Daily and 4H; price is pulling back into a 1H gap inside that trend.

decision.why: Right location, no confirmation: wait. Passing outright gives up the real entry that follows; buying now is early.

take.why: Not yet. The confirmation is the missing piece.

draw.why: The previous day high is the pool above.
